verdict.rationale: Community users describe Linear as fast and quicker to load than Jira, even under a DDoS attack, though one user found its 50ms interactions and animations slow. None of these reports concern workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks, and the pack has no documentation of issue or item caps; the published API rate limits govern request volume, not workspace size. Missing for 10: documented issue/item caps or plan limits, performance benchmarks or guidance for large workspaces, and independent reports from large-scale deployments.
